_format: JSON is used instead of YAML so scripts/eudamed_watch.py stays stdlib-only (no PyYAML). Fields per entry: label (unique), trade_name_query, optional manufacturer_contains, optional expected_srn, optional note.
_standing_note: trade_name_query is a case-insensitive UNANCHORED substring match on the EUDAMED API. Short strings return unrelated devices (e.g. 'OPRA' also matches unrelated products); rows are therefore filtered client-side by manufacturer_contains (case-insensitive substring of manufacturerName). Zero rows means 'not findable under that string', not 'not registered'. Nothing produced from this list is a compliance statement about any named company.
